description: The Maldives Bureau of Statistics publishes results tables from the 2022 Population and Housing Census in Excel and PDF. The housing set has eight tables. Table H7 counts households by drinking water source for each atoll, splitting rain water into treated and untreated, desalinated and bottled water, with the share using safe drinking water. Nationally 74.2 percent of 94,424 households used safe drinking water, against 99.9 percent in Male' and about half on the administrative islands. Other tables give households and population by type of living quarters and rooms for each island, and asset ownership by atoll. Atoll profiles, five of which were linked when read, chart safe water, rented housing and garbage collection island by island. Coverage is national. Format and access: free XLSX and PDF; census microdata for 2014 and 2022 can be requested through a form. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the tables cover water but not electricity or sanitation; profiles are charts, partly in Dhivehi; the .Stat Suite portal did not respond from the cloud. Simulation uses: reliance on rain and desalinated water by atoll for water security and climate adaptation on low islands. Related records: the Maldives critical infrastructure locations dataset.
